{{Quote|Karagga graciously reminds guests that this area is not intended for visitors.|The Herald of Karagga, to a group of invaders in Karagga's palace|<ref name="SWTOR HH" />}}
The '''Herald of Karagga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]]-programmed [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who worked for [[Karagga]] the Unyielding, leader of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] shortly after the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] stood by his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] master's side and delivered messages on behalf of his master. After Karagga's [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], the Herald was eventually discovered and put up for auction on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], along with all of Karagga's secrets within the droid. The Herald was stuck in a loop, repeating his standardized warning "Karagga graciously reminds guests that this area is not intended for visitors." over and over." [[Hylo Visz]] dispatched [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] to purchase and recover the droid.<ref name="SWTOR HH" />
